Flecks are 2-6 px, packed evenly edge to edge, with no direction. From a distance: A deep ocean-navy with an even cyan glitter haze; individual flecks merge into a shimmery dark blue. Measured spec (average): metal 17, roughness 74, coat 65. Shine: satin. Metal: none. It brings its own colours.
